§ Egypt = "land of the Copts"
a country at the northeastern section of Africa, adjacent to Palestine, and through which the Nile flows
Egyptians = "double straits"

Αἴγυπτος, ου, ἡ, 
Egypt: Mat.2.13-15,19, Act.2.10; 7.9-39, Heb.3.16; 11.26,27; γῆ Αἴ., Act.7.40; 13.17, Heb.8.9, Jude.5 (cf. Exo.5.12, al.); ἡ Αἴ., Act.7.11 figuratively, of Jerusalem as hostile to God, Rev.11.8.†
(AS)

Meri, a name for Egypt 
Another spelling of mits.ra.yim (מִצְרַ֫יִם "Egypt" H4714G)
This name means rebellion, rebellious

"Matsor", a name for Egypt
Another spelling of mits.ra.yim (מִצְרַ֫יִם "Egypt" H4714G) 
This name means siege, entrenchment
